description:
Why this issue exists: http_sign.rs RsaActorKey stores an rsa::RsaPrivateKey. sign_post() calls SigningKey::from(self.private_key.clone()) to construct the signing key on every call. RSA private key cloning involves allocating and copying large BigUint values. For high-volume ActivityPub delivery (fan-out to thousands of followers) this is unnecessary per-delivery allocation.

What needs to be done: Store a pre-constructed rsa::pkcs1v15::SigningKey<sha2::Sha256> directly in RsaActorKey rather than the raw RsaPrivateKey. The signing key can be built once at key-load time. SigningKey implements Clone cheaply if needed, but ideally just hold Arc<SigningKey>.
title: RsaPrivateKey cloned to construct SigningKey on each outbound ActivityPub delivery
